MapLibre GL JS 5.24.1 (BSD-3-Clause, licence text in LICENSE-maplibre-gl.txt), the CSP build, copied unmodified from the npm package
`maplibre-gl@5.24.1` /dist/: maplibre-gl-csp.js, maplibre-gl-csp-worker.js and maplibre-gl.css. The only change is that the trailing
"sourceMappingURL" comment line was deleted from the two .js files, so a browser's developer tools do not ask for source maps we do not ship.

maplibre-gl-leaflet 0.1.4 (ISC, LICENSE-maplibre-gl-leaflet.txt): leaflet-maplibre-gl.js, copied unmodified from the npm package
`@maplibre/maplibre-gl-leaflet@0.1.4` /dist/. It draws a MapLibre vector map as one Leaflet layer, so the Atlas's Leaflet markers and layers
sit on top of it unchanged.

Used only by the vector basemap looks (Liberty, Smooth, Smooth dark, Ink, Ink dark), loaded by public/js/basemaps.js the first time one of
them is shown. A visitor who never picks one downloads none of it. The CSP build is used because Compass's policy (worker-src 'self') does not
allow the blob: worker the ordinary build starts; basemaps.js points MapLibre at maplibre-gl-csp-worker.js, a same-origin file, instead.

To update: `npm pack maplibre-gl@X @maplibre/maplibre-gl-leaflet@Y` in an empty folder, copy the same files, delete the sourceMappingURL lines,
change the versions above and in public/js/basemaps.js (MAPLIBRE_VERSION), and look at every vector look on the Atlas map, Compass and History.
